1099 warning threshold
We'll flag any musician whose payments cross this in a calendar year, so you can collect a W-9 before it's urgent.
Warn me about 1099s
Off means no flags, badges or alerts, and 1099s is hidden from the menu. You can turn it back on in Settings.
$
The IRS filing threshold changes by tax year. Setting your own warning lower buys you time to chase paperwork.
You'll still be able to ask CAI who needs a 1099 — the app just won't raise it on its own. You can turn this back on in Settings.
Camera and mileage
Nothing to grant here. iOS asks for each one the first time you use it, and you can say no.
Camera
Photograph receipts and checks so the details fill themselves in. iOS asks for the camera the first time you scan.
Mileage
Add a drive by hand, or turn on Auto tracking on the Mileage page and your drives are logged for you. iOS asks for location only when you turn that on.
Read answers aloud
CAI speaks its answer as well as showing it. Turn this off and answers stay on screen only.

Home Office
See if you qualify and estimate your deduction.
Estimated deduction
{{ hoAllowedFmt }}
i
Answer all three questions to calculate your deduction.
Your {{ hoLimitIncomeFmt }} of business income this year is already used up by {{ hoLimitExpensesFmt }} of expenses, so there is no profit for a home office to come out of. It cannot make a business run at a loss.
{{ hoComputedFmt }} is what the space itself is worth — it comes back as soon as the business shows a profit.
{{ hoUnclassifiedFmt }} of that is not marked business or personal yet, so it counts as business and holds this figure down. Open any expense to mark it — tap here for the list.
Worked out to {{ hoComputedFmt }}, capped at {{ hoLimitFmt }} — {{ hoLimitIncomeFmt }} of business income less {{ hoLimitExpensesFmt }} of expenses. A home office cannot make your business run at a loss.
{{ hoCarryoverFmt }} carries forward to next year.
{{ hoLostFmt }} is lost — the simplified option carries nothing forward. The regular method would keep it.
{{ homeOfficeSource }} · {{ homeOfficeYear }} figures. An estimate for planning, not tax advice.

Used only for work

Tap to pay
Pay with Apple Pay and the expense files itself — amount, merchant and category — before you have left the register. Set up once, in Shortcuts.
1. Shortcuts → Automation → +
2. Choose Wallet, pick your cards, turn on Run Immediately
3. New Blank Automation → add Log Tap from CrehzTracker
4. Set Amount to Shortcut Input → Amount, and Merchant to Shortcut Input → Merchant
Tap each variable after inserting it to choose the property — inserting Shortcut Input on its own gives the merchant twice and no amount.

AI features send some of your data to other companies
CrehzTracker uses AI to read receipts, suggest categories and answer your questions. That only works by sending data to the companies below. Nothing is sent until you agree.
Anthropic — reading and answering
Receipt photos and text, notes you dictate or write, and a new shop’s name with your category names. When you ask CAI a question, your whole ledger goes with it: every expense, income entry, drive and payee.
OpenAI — voice and logos
The text of CAI’s replies, if you choose one of its voices. The business name and description you type, if you ask for a logo.
Sent only to do what you asked. Never sold, never used for advertising. Not now keeps everything by hand. Change your mind any time in Settings › Capture. Privacy policy ›
